title: ORIX USA’s Digital Infrastructure Group Provides HoldCo Facility to Leading Distributed Generation Platform
summary: ORIX USA’s Digital Infrastructure Group (“ODI”) is pleased to announce its role as a lender in a $250 million secured borrowing base cred
body_markdown:
ORIX USA’s[Digital Infrastructure Group](https://www.orix.com/private-credit/digital-infrastructure/) (“ODI”) is pleased to announce its role as a lender in a $250 million secured borrowing base credit facility (the “HoldCo Facility”) for a leading U.S. distributed generation solar platform backed by a global infrastructure investment manager.


The HoldCo Facility provides access to flexible, corporate-level capital to support the continued development, construction, and stabilization of a diversified portfolio of community solar, net metering, and behind-the-meter solar assets across the United States.


Distributed generation is an increasingly critical source of incremental capacity in constrained load pockets, where interconnection queues and transmission bottlenecks have limited the pace of new power supply. This transaction reflects ODI’s ongoing commitment to financing the power generation, storage, and transmission infrastructure required to meet accelerating electricity demand across the United States.
